content.short: Boss Track is a DeFi portfolio tracker compatible with multiple chains.
content.description: Boss Track helps you monitor the performance of your on-chain assets by delivering real-time updates for your entire wallet and every individual asset in a single, intuitive dashboard. The service is free to use and permissionless, so anyone can connect their wallet address to begin tracking their DeFi portfolio without needing to access a dedicated Web3 site. It supports multiple networks, including BSC, Ethereum, Polygon, Cronos, Avalanche, and more, making it easy to keep an eye on your cross-chain activity.
content.meta: Boss Track tracks on-chain asset performance across multiple chains in real time. Discover Boss Track and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
